sentence: This project studies how caloric restriction and several proteins affect atherosclerosis, obesity and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, which raise the risk of cardiovascular disease.
This project tests whether an immunity protein in Pseudomonas aeruginosa also works as a transcription factor that controls biofilm.
This project studies how microbes in the mouth affect long-lasting oral infection in children exposed to or infected with HIV.
This project studies how the damaged lining of the bowel heals through a response that starts in the skin-like anal transition zone.
This project studies in detail how the CRISPR interference system in prokaryotes works.
This project studies how motors called myosin-I that sit on membranes work with actin to shape cells.
This project builds an AI tool that monitors patients at home by combining urine biomarkers with other health information.
This project builds a fast method to tell the age of mosquitoes in the field using machine learning.
This project collects and analyzes MRI imaging from people who carry mutations that cause Alzheimer's disease, and from their siblings.
This project supports a shared sequencing resource that helps cancer researchers analyze genomes.
This project studies the structural features that let antibodies carry out effector functions in infectious disease and cancer.
This project tests whether antisense oligonucleotides can fix splicing changes and protein aggregates in neurons and glia in X-linked dystonia parkinsonism.
This project tests a CRISPR-based blood test that detects cell-free DNA from Mycobacterium avium complex to track pulmonary disease.
This project maps the cell types in the human dorsal root ganglion and spinal cord and how they change in chronic pain.
This project extends a sequencing-based approach to screen for COVID-19 and emerging pathogens such as monkey pox and Polio.
This project tests how two anti-cancer compounds kill human cancer cells and whether they kill human cancers growing in mice.
This project studies how substance use disorders relate to other forms of psychopathology using phenotypic classification and statistical genetics.
This project develops drugs to treat pancreatic cancer, a disease with no cure.
This project studies changing malaria patterns in West Africa and tests ways to control malaria and stop its transmission.
This project studies how feedback from the hippocampus changes the way the main olfactory bulb represents environment and odors in mice.
